summary: Privileged access snapshot and JIT 'jump' role provisioning for cloud entitlement audit
description:
Issue summary:
Perform a full entitlement snapshot across primary AWS and GCP orgs and provision a Just-In-Time (JIT) "jump" role for on-call and security engineers to use during the upcoming privilege audit. The snapshot will capture IAM role bindings, service account key usage, and cross-account trust relationships at the organization and project level.

Background:
- Quarterly security audit requires an authoritative mapping of who can assume high-privilege roles across our cloud accounts.
- Previous audits revealed stale role bindings in a handful of projects and two service accounts with unexpected broad scopes.
- We need a reproducible snapshot plus a short-lived, auditable JIT mechanism so investigators can access resources without increasing standing privileges.

Request / Acceptance criteria:
1) Generate and checkpoint a machine-readable entitlement snapshot for: all AWS management accounts, prod and staging GCP projects listed in org-structure, and Dedicated customer account links. Snapshot should include: role ARN/role ID, attached policies, inline policies, trust relationships, last-used metadata for principals, and service account key ages.
2) Create a JIT "jump" role in both clouds: minimal-assume-policy that requires ephemeral MFA + SSO approval and logs all assume events into security audit stream. Configure TTL = 1 hour, default session tags include requestor and runbook-id.
3) Validate that the JIT role can access read-only diagnostic routes needed by oncall (logs, instance metadata, cluster describe) without write privileges. Provide a short demo runbook for oncall.
4) Produce an artifacts bundle: entitlement snapshot (JSON/CSV), diff vs last-quarter snapshot, runbook for using JIT role, and a short remediation plan listing top-10 findings.

Environment/Scope:
- Primary focus: prod/us-west and prod/us-east AWS/GCP orgs. Include staging snapshots for comparison. Do NOT modify customer-dedicated accounts without explicit approval.

Risk and rollback:
- JIT role creation involves IAM policy changes; keep changes additive and scoped to a single role per account. If audit stream shows unexpected assume events, revoke role trust and disable immediately.

Approvals required:
- Security (Priya Kapoor) sign-off on policy templates.
- Cloud Ops (Diego Morales) approval for cross-account IAM changes.

Notes:
- Prefer using existing infra tooling (cloud-asset-inventory export for GCP, IAM Access Analyzer + custom script for AWS) and store snapshots in private audit S3/GCS buckets with retention set to 365 days.
- Coordinate a 30-minute dry-run with oncall before the audit window.
